mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and a comfortable 64 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School.
Local authorities have provided a summary of police activity from August 31 to September 14, including investigations into traffic incidents and other community reports.
There is plenty to do today including the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and pizza and pitchers at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
One notable report from the police department occurred on September 5, when officers investigated several reports of a viral prank where vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields.
Today's flavor is unavailable as the Culver's location is currently closed for a remodel. We look forward to their reopening.
